legend: Johnny drives a truck and must deliver a package from his hometown to the district center. His hometown is located at point 0 on a number line, and the district center is located at the point d.

Johnny's truck has a gas tank that holds exactly n liters, and his tank is initially full. As he drives, the truck consumes exactly one liter per unit distance traveled. Moreover, there are m gas stations located at various points along the way to the district center. The i-th station is located at the point xi on the number line and sells an unlimited amount of fuel at a price of pi dollars per liter. Find the minimum cost Johnny must pay for fuel to successfully complete the delivery.
input: The first line of input contains three space separated integers d, n, and m (1 ≤ n ≤ d ≤ 109, 1 ≤ m ≤ 200 000) — the total distance to the district center, the volume of the gas tank, and the number of gas stations, respectively.

Each of the next m lines contains two integers xi, pi (1 ≤ xi ≤ d - 1, 1 ≤ pi ≤ 106) — the position and cost of gas at the i-th gas station. It is guaranteed that the positions of the gas stations are distinct.
output: Print a single integer — the minimum cost to complete the delivery. If there is no way to complete the delivery, print -1.
note: In the first sample, Johnny's truck holds 4 liters. He can drive 3 units to the first gas station, buy 2 liters of gas there (bringing the tank to 3 liters total), drive 3 more units to the third gas station, buy 4 liters there to fill up his tank, and then drive straight to the district center. His total cost is 2·5 + 4·3 = 22 dollars.
In the second sample, there is no way for Johnny to make it to the district center, as his tank cannot hold enough gas to take him from the latest gas station to the district center.

note.ai: 在第一个样例中，Johnny 的卡车油箱可容纳 4 升汽油。他可以行驶 3 个单位距离到达第一个加油站，在那里购买 2 升汽油（使油箱中的汽油总量达到 3 升），再行驶 3 个单位距离到达第三个加油站，在那里购买 4 升汽油将油箱加满，然后直接开到区中心。他的总花费为 2·5 + 4·3 = 22 美元。
在第二个样例中，Johnny 无法到达区中心，因为他的油箱无法装下足够的汽油，以供他从最后一个加油站行驶到区中心。

legend.ai: Johnny 驾驶一辆卡车，必须将一个包裹从他的家乡运送到区中心。他的家乡位于数轴上的点 0 处，区中心位于点 d 处。
Johnny 的卡车有一个恰好可容纳 n 升燃油的油箱，且油箱初始时是满的。行驶过程中，卡车每行驶一个单位距离恰好消耗一升燃油。此外，沿前往区中心的道路上分布着 m 个加油站。第 i 个加油站位于数轴上的点 x_i 处，以每升 p_i 美元的价格出售不限量的燃油。求 Johnny 为顺利完成配送必须支付的最小燃油费用。

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含三个用空格分隔的整数 d、n 和 m（1 ≤ n ≤ d ≤ 10^9，1 ≤ m ≤ 200 000）——分别表示到区中心的总距离、油箱容量以及加油站的数量。
接下来的 m 行中，每行包含两个整数 x_i、p_i（1 ≤ x_i ≤ d - 1，1 ≤ p_i ≤ 10^6）——分别表示第 i 个加油站的位置和燃油价格。保证所有加油站的位置互不相同。

output.ai: 输出一个整数——完成配送所需的最小费用。如果无法完成配送，则输出 -1。
